note: Colorado Parks & Wildlife, inside an Arkansas River meander near Howard, across the river from Rincon (~0.5 km) but reached from the north side: from US-50 at mile marker 227 (about 4.7 miles east of Salida), Fremont CR 7 then CR 45, a dirt road with narrow single-lane stretches and a tight turn under a railroad trestle (12 ft 3 in high, 10 ft 6 in wide). CPW does not recommend the east approach (4WD with a water crossing). Gold panning is allowed here. --Claude
